text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Lebuh Raya Bertingkat Sungai Besi-Ulu Kelang) 2022.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 16 September 2022.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Bertingkat Sungai Besi–

Ulu Kelang yang bermula dari kilometer 7.128 Lebuh Raya Bertingkat Sungai Besi–

Ulu Kelang di koordinat U -66766.516, T 26937.495, Geosentrik Datum Malaysia

(GDM2000) dan berakhir di kilometer 22.984 di koordinat U -54575.082, T 28287.27,

Geosentrik Datum Malaysia (GDM2000) termasuklah Persimpangan Bertingkat CherasKajang, Persimpangan Bertingkat Cheras Hartamas, Plaza Tol Bukit Teratai,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Bukit Teratai, Persimpangan Bertingkat Tasik Tambahan,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Permai, Persimpangan Bertingkat Kosas, Plaza Tol Ampang,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Pekan Ampang, Persimpangan Bertingkat Ampang Point,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Ulu Kelang, Persimpangan Bertingkat Hill View, Persimpangan

Bertingkat Bukit Antarabangsa dan jalan-jalan sambungannya, iaitu suatu jarak

sepanjang 15.856 kilometer, diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (SUNGAI BESI-ULU KELANG ELEVATED EXPRESSWAY) ORDER 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959 [Act 376],

the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Selangor, makes the

following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Sungai Besi-Ulu Kelang

Elevated Expressway) Order 2022.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 16 September 2022.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) The part of the road known as the Sungai Besi–Ulu Kelang Elevated

Expressway commencing from kilometre 7.128 of Sungai Besi–Ulu Kelang Elevated

Expressway at coordinates N -66766.516, E 26937.495, Geocentric Datum for Malaysia

(GDM2000) and ending at the kilometre 22.984 at coordinate N -54575.082, E 28287.27,

Geocentric Datum for Malaysia (GDM2000) including the Cheras-Kajang Interchange,

Cheras Hartamas Interchange, Bukit Teratai Toll Plaza, Bukit Teratai Interchange, Tasik

Tambahan Interchange, Permai Interchange, Kosas Interchange, Ampang Toll Plaza,

Pekan Ampang Interchange, Ampang Point Interchange, Ulu Kelang Interchange,

Hill View Interchange, Bukit Antarabangsa Interchange and its link roads, being a

distance of 15.856 kilometres, is declared to be a Federal road.

(2) The road declared to be Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown on

the map in the Schedule.
